io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.a2aCompatibility: Separate /discovery/a2a supports synchronous SendMessage and message/send. Explicit free_* actions support a bounded guest trial without signup, reading repository documentation or answering questions through DeepWiki. Find schemas at /public/services?protocol=mcp. Shared cache by public arguments; no guest status/history, streaming or push delivery.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.explicitTools: tools/list provides full schemas for free_* tools on both provider protocols. Supply requestKey and arguments, not contractId. Guest inputs must be public; results may be cached by arguments. Guidance only recommends tools; it never buys them.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.modernHttp: 2026-07-28 supports server/discover, tools/list and tools/call with per-request metadata and matching MCP-Protocol-Version, Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers. No initialize/session. JSON response mode; subscriptions and input requests not offered.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.registration: No signup needed for advertised free_* trial tools. For account execution/history follow OAuth onboarding; private history remains authenticated.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.resultRecovery: Guest: repeat the same explicit tool and arguments for its cached result; no guest status/history. Account: keep requestKey and use execution_status. No automatic replacement of uncertain operations.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.scope: Public discovery and bounded free_* guest executions. Generic execute, durable account history and payments are not available anonymously. No public payments.
